sourceReview.reason: The November 2 HKMA EnsembleTX upgrade to 24/7 tokenized central-bank-money settlement, including 12 banks and 20 industry pioneers, is already captured in the published Ant International brief and the existing Standard Chartered inbox lead; this report adds no distinct launch, transaction, approval or expansion event.
